text:
Nina: Heads-up 4 Zephyrus case study timeline update. Need final signed quote, a one-paragraph exec quote, and webinar microsite copy by EOD Mon.
Omar: I can own the asset assembly and the short promo clip. Where do you want the final hero quote to live?
Priya: For hero quote, ask Mark for something punchy around performance + cost. Prefer 'X% cost' only if legal ok.
Sam: Quick note: Zephyrus has strict trademark language for product names. LegalBot, can you confirm?
LegalBot: Automated check: Zephyrus legal requires written approval for numeric claims and a trademark usage blurb. See policy: https://redwood.company/legal/partner-trademark.
Nina: Cool. Omar, please grab the signed email and drop it in the doc. Also we need a short customer-facing statistic block for the blog and a one-sentence pull quote for the landing hero.
Omar: Will request signed confirmation now. Draft quote I shared with Mark: "Redwood reduced our inference cost by half while improving our search latency by 3x." Keeping it literal to match their internal A/B.
Priya: Suggest tightening: "Cut inference cost by 50% and improved search latency 3x (as measured in Zephyrus Q1 A/B)." That covers the measurement.
Sam: Zephyrus legal replied: they can approve numeric claims only if we reference their benchmark and include their consent email. Also asked to avoid 'our' when ambiguous 4 prefer 'Zephyrus'.
Omar: Got their email approval and pasted it into the doc. Dropped files: s3://redwood-cms/zephyrus/transcript.pdf and s3://redwood-cms/zephyrus/clip-30s.mp4
Nina: Great. Marketing-bot note: embargo policy requires signed approval + 48h pre-announce for partner customers.
marketing-bot: Reminder: embargo policy link: https://redwood.company/policy/embargo. Required: signed quote, trademark ack, 48h window.
Priya: Webinar plan: Thurs 6/6 11am PT. Speakers: Mark (Zephyrus), Priya (Product), Omar (Solutions). Nina to moderate. Need slide deck + 10-min demo.
Sam: I'll handle partner ops and invite Zephyrus legal to review the landing copy. Also routing inbound demo leads to AE queue after webinar.
Omar: Landing draft at https://redwood.hubspot.com/zephyrus-launch. Please comment.
Nina: Copy tweaks: lead with customer outcome, include the 'as measured by' parenthetical near the statistic, and add a single CTA: 'Register'. I'll push edits by 3pm.
Priya: I'll prepare the 5-slide highlight deck and demo script. Omar, can you record the micro-demo by Tue?
Omar: Yes. Plan to record Wed morning and upload.
LegalBot: Final status: signed approval received, trademark blurb received, numeric claims approved with 'as measured by Zephyrus Q1 A/B' clause.
Nina: Awesome. Timeline: publish blog + hero post Tue 6/4 9:00 PT, webinar Thurs 6/6 11am PT. Team confirm you have what you need.
Sam: Confirmed 4 partner ops checklist updated.
Omar: Assets uploaded and linked in doc.
Priya: Got it, prepping slides and registration nurture.
marketing-bot: Publication scheduled: 1733312400 -> Tue 6/4 09:00 PT (scheduled).
